verrou.texte: To open this app, you first need to add:
verrou.manque.casino: the Super Mario 64 DS files, or the Badge Arcade ones
verrou.aide: This button takes you to where you add them.
verrou.import_en_cours: An import is still running: these files arrive when it finishes. Come back once it's done.
steamu.importer.aide: USB stick, SD card or Downloads
steamu.import.mauvaise: This is a console sound, but its quality is too low: find a better copy ({noms})
steamu.import.pas_wiiu: This sound is not a console sound SteamU knows: {n}
steamu.import.verrouilles: This 3DS file is still locked: the 3DS key is needed first ({n})
steamu.import.trop: Left aside, too big or too many: {n}
steamu.guide.prudence: We only copy: don't touch anything else in GodMode9.
steamu.bientot: Coming soon: SteamU can't read this file yet
steamu.guide.mii.1: You need a 3DS with GodMode9. Turn it on while holding START: GodMode9 opens.
steamu.guide.mii.2: Open [1:] SYSNAND CTRNAND, then data, then the folder with the long name.
steamu.guide.mii.4: A on the file 00000005, then “Mount as DIFF image”. Say yes to open it.
steamu.guide.mii.5: A on partitionA.bin, then “Copy to 0:/gm9/out”. Those are your Mii!
steamu.guide.mii.6: Turn the 3DS off. Put its SD card here, then Import files: gm9 › out › partitionA.bin.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.1: Without this key, the 3DS files that are still locked can't be read (Badge Arcade, menu sounds…). It comes from YOUR 3DS: SteamU never provides it.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.2: You need a 3DS with GodMode9. Turn it on while holding START: GodMode9 opens.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.3: Go down to [M:] MEMORY VIRTUAL and open it with A.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.4: A on the boot9.bin file, then « Copy to 0:/gm9/out ». That's the key!
steamu.guide.cle3ds.5: Turn the 3DS off. Put its SD card here, then Import files: gm9 › out › boot9.bin.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.prudence: This key is yours: don't share it with anyone.
steamu.guide.luigi.1: You need a 3DS with GodMode9 and your Super Mario 64 DS cartridge. Put the cartridge in the 3DS.
steamu.guide.luigi.2: Turn the 3DS on while holding START: GodMode9 opens.
steamu.guide.luigi.3: Open [C:] GAMECART: you see the game file, ending in .nds.
steamu.guide.luigi.4: A on the .nds file, then “Copy to 0:/gm9/out”.
steamu.guide.luigi.5: Do you also have Mario Party DS? Copy it the same way: Luigi will get all his moves.
steamu.guide.badges.1: You need a 3DS with GodMode9 and Badge Arcade installed. Turn it on while holding START.
steamu.guide.badges.2: Press HOME, choose “Title manager”, then [A:] SYSNAND SD.
steamu.guide.badges.3: Pick Badge Arcade with A, then “Open title folder”.
steamu.guide.badges.4: A on the biggest .app file, then “NCCH image options…” and “Mount image to drive”.
steamu.guide.badges.5: Go to the romfs folder and press Y to copy it to 0:/gm9/out.
steamu.guide.sons3ds.sous: 3DS (including Mii Maker and Mii Plaza), Wii U, Switch, Badge Arcade, casino
steamu.guide.sons3ds.1: Do you have console sounds (flac, wav, ogg, mp3, bcstm…)? SteamU listens to them one by one.
steamu.guide.sons3ds.2: Import them all at once, even mixed with other files.
steamu.guide.sons3ds.3: Each recognized sound goes to its place: menu, shop, button sounds… The others are left aside.
steamu.guide.wiiu.sous: The plaza, the menu, the eShop, Mii Maker
steamu.guide.wiiu.1: You need a modded Wii U (Aroma or Tiramisu) with the dumpling app, and an SD card or a USB stick.
steamu.guide.wiiu.2: On the Wii U, start dumpling.
steamu.guide.wiiu.3: Choose to copy the system applications, including the Wii U Menu. Wait until it's done.
steamu.guide.wiiu.4: Put the SD card (or the stick) here, then Import files: the dumpling folder.
steamu.guide.wiiu.5: Already have music files (ogg, mp3, m4a, wav, bfstm…)? Import them: SteamU recognizes each Wii U track by listening to it and puts it in its place.
steamu.guide.wiiu.prudence: We only copy: don't change anything else on the Wii U.
steamu.guide.switch.1: There is no simple, safe way to copy the Switch sounds, even from your own console.
steamu.guide.switch.2: Already have Switch sounds (ogg, mp3, wav, flac)? Import them: SteamU recognizes each sound by listening and puts it in its place.
steamu.guide.switch.prudence: Only the sounds SteamU recognizes are kept.

casino.conseil_luigi_note: Luigi's advice: “{conseil}” When you bet, each Mii calls (matches it) if their hand is good, otherwise they fold and leave their bet in the pot. Hands: Pair < Two Pair < Three of a Kind < Full House < Four of a Kind < Flush (5 of a kind). Cards: Cloud < Mushroom < Flower < Luigi < Mario < Star.
casino.poker_note: A hand better than Luigi's wins. Bet {mise}: a pair pays {gain} coins. Tie: bet returned. Card order: Cloud < Mushroom < Flower < Luigi < Mario < Star.
casino.machine_a_sous_gains: Slot Machine Payouts (1 coin a spin)
casino.super_etoile_note: The super star replaces any symbol. The reel keeps sliding two to four more slots after you press: watch for the super star!
casino.sur_une_image: On a picture (1 slot out of 12)
casino.roulette_note: Up to 5 coins on the table. A coin on a color wins about half the time; on a picture, rarely, but pays 12 times the bet.
casino.jeu_poker_resume: A better hand than Luigi's: pair ×2 … flush ×16.
casino.jeu_machine_resume: Three reels, 1 coin a spin; the super star is a wild.
casino.jeu_roulette_resume: Up to 5 coins on the table; a picture pays ×12.
casino.jeu_table_resume: Five players, 5 coins to join: the best hand takes the pot.

steamu.guide.moteur.1: Real Miis need two things. The engine: press "Install" just above, SteamU takes care of it. The faces and bodies: they are Nintendo files, SteamU is not allowed to ship them.
steamu.guide.moteur.2: You only need one file: the faces file, FFLResHigh.dat (Wii U) or AFLResHigh_2_3.dat (Miitomo). Scan the code to see where to find it, then press "Import". Bodies are extra: without them, SteamU draws its own.
steamu.guide.moteur.qr1: Where to find the faces file
steamu.guide.luigi.6: Turn the 3DS off. Put its SD card here, then Import files: gm9 › out.
steamu.guide.badges.6: Turn the 3DS off. Put its SD card here, then Import files: gm9 › out. Add boot9.bin too (3DS key guide) for locked files.
steamu.guide.sons3ds.prudence: Only the sounds SteamU recognizes are kept.
steamu.guide.moteur.prudence: Nothing is downloaded without your OK.
steamu.moteur.aide: What draws and animates the real Miis. Downloaded from the FFL.js project, only when you press.

arcade.entrainement_sous: free, to get the hang of it
arcade.astuce_1: Keep your finger on the glass to aim, then let go to drop the claw!
arcade.astuce_2: Big badges are heavy: aim right for the middle, or they'll slip.
arcade.astuce_3: Every achievement you unlock in your games earns you a play. Go play, then come back and see me!
arcade.astuce_4: The pusher only pushes toward the slot: put the arm right behind the pile.
arcade.astuce_5: In practice, 10 tokens caught = 1 free play. Handy, right?
arcade.astuce_6: The machines change every day. Tomorrow, new series!
arcade.astuce_7: In your box, pick a badge and stick it on your Home screen.
arcade.astuce_8: Big badges are won in pieces. Stick them side by side on the Home screen and they join up!
arcade.astuce_9: Rather win big badges in one go? Press X in the hall.
arcade.dire_morceaux: Big badges in pieces, just like in the app! Win each piece, then stick them side by side on the Home screen.
arcade.dire_entiers: Whole big badges! One grab for the entire badge… but they're heavy!
arcade.dire_entrainement: Practice! It's free: 10 tokens caught = 1 free play.
arcade.resume_morceaux: Including {n} big badge pieces to collect!
arcade.consigne_pince:
Keep your finger on the glass to aim,
let go to drop the claw.
arcade.consigne_pousseur:
Put the arm behind the pile,
then push toward the slot!
arcade.gratuit_volonte: Free, as much as you like.
arcade.dire_ici_entraine: Here you practice for free. Aim at a token and let go!
arcade.dire_vide_champion: This machine is empty: you won everything! Bravo, champ!
arcade.dire_plus_parties: You're out of plays… Come back tomorrow, or unlock achievements in your games!
arcade.dire_vise: Aim well, and may the claw be with you!
arcade.dire_pousse: Push gently… everything that falls in the slot is yours!
arcade.dire_refus: Oh no, no more plays! Come back tomorrow, or unlock achievements in your games: each one gives you a play.
arcade.dire_vide_voisine: This machine is empty. Try the one next to it!
arcade.dire_glisse_milieu: It slipped! Grab it right in the middle.
arcade.dire_bonus_jetons: Bravo! 10 tokens: here's a free play!
arcade.dire_glisse_pince: Ouch, it slipped out of the claw! Aim closer to the center.
arcade.dire_ca_bouge: It's moving, it's moving… one more push!
arcade.dire_grand_complet: INCREDIBLE! You've got all the pieces: the big badge is complete!
arcade.dire_un_morceau: A big badge piece! {n} more to find.
arcade.dire_encore_un: Another one for your box! That's quite a pile.
arcade.dire_grand_badge: INCREDIBLE! A big badge! You're a real champ!
arcade.dire_nouvel_accueil: Badges stick on the new Home screen! Choose it in Themes, under the "Home" setting.
arcade.boite_vide:
Your box is empty for now.
Badges arrive once the collection is placed in the console's private folder (outils/badges-extraire.py).

arcade.note_incomplet: The grayed-out pieces are waiting for you in the machines. Pick a piece to stick it.

Never sent: your Steam account, your friends, your games. Your Internet address is never kept. No account, nothing to fill in, and you can stop it all right here. If you are under 15, ask an adult before you say yes.
